name: war-world
description: A server-authoritative Roblox PvPvE survival vertical slice built with TypeScript.

scripts.rojo:build: mkdir -p build && rojo build default.project.json --output build/WarWorld.rbxlx
scripts.rojo:sourcemap: mkdir -p build && rojo sourcemap default.project.json --output build/sourcemap.json
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run format:check && npm run rojo:sourcemap && npm run validate && npm run rojo:build
